abstract: Using a specific antiserum to human syncytial trophoblast plasma membrane (TrPM), we have investigated the expression of these antigens on a variety of trophoblastic and non-trophoblastic tissues by a standard peroxidase/anti-peroxidase staining method. Normal placenta (first-trimester as well as full-term), placenta from tubal pregnancy and placenta accreta were all found to express TrPM antigens. However, malignant change in trophoblast neoplasms appeared to by accompanied by a loss of these antigens, with 7 out of 10 specimens of hydatidiform mole staining positively while 3 specimens of invasive mole and 7 specimens of choriocarcinoma were all negative. In contrast, a number of malignant tumours of non-trophoblastic origin such as carcinomas of the colon, cervix, bladder and hepatomas were found to express TrPM antigens. The possible significance of the reversal to a trophoblast phenotype by malignant neoplasms of non-trophoblastic origin is discussed.
abstract_ja: 合胞栄養膜の原形質膜(TrPM)に対する特異的抗血清を用い、正常および異常胎盤と、栄養膜由来および非栄養膜由来の各種腫瘍における抗原の発現を、標準的なペルオキシダーゼ・抗ペルオキシダーゼ染色法により検討した。正常胎盤(妊娠初期および満期)、子宮外妊娠の胎盤、癒着胎盤はいずれもTrPM抗原を発現していた。しかし、栄養膜性腫瘍の悪性化に伴い、この抗原の発現は消失する傾向がみられた。胞状奇胎10例中7例が陽性であったのに対し、侵入奇胎3例と絨毛癌7例はすべて陰性であった。一方、大腸癌、子宮頸癌、膀胱癌、肝細胞癌などの非栄養膜由来の悪性腫瘍には、TrPM抗原を発現するものがみられた。栄養膜様形質への転換が非栄養膜由来の悪性腫瘍で生じることの意義について考察する。
